name: Java Sdk
headline: Java SDK for Model Context Protocol
short_description: The Java SDK for Model Context Protocol enables integration with Model Context Protocol servers and clients. Developed in collaboration with Spring AI, it provides strong tools for building AI-driven applications in Java.
author: modelcontextprotocol

sections.overview:
The java-sdk is the official Model Context Protocol implementation for Java developers, providing tools to build AI-driven applications that integrate seamlessly with MCP servers and clients. Developed in collaboration with Spring AI, it enables Java applications to communicate with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI tools through the standardized Model Context Protocol. The SDK supports resource management, tool invocation, prompt handling, and bidirectional message exchange. It includes features like JSON Schema validation, icon and metadata support per SEP-973, and comprehensive error handling for both recoverable tool errors and protocol-level errors. Teams building enterprise Java applications with AI capabilities benefit from strong typing, Spring Framework integration, and active maintenance from the Model Context Protocol community.
Integrate AI models into existing Java applications for enhanced functionality.
Build robust client-server applications utilizing the Model Context Protocol.
Enhance legacy Java applications with modern AI capabilities.
Develop scalable enterprise-level AI solutions tailored to business requirements.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: GitHub Copilot, VS Code
